title: Stop synthetic exposure when authentication regresses
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Break candidate authentication; detect forced reauthentication or rejected valid sessions.
sourceAcceptance: Detect login/session failures before expanding the affected cohort.
backlogAcceptance: Authentication failures stop expansion without bypassing validation; affected users remain counted.
preconditions: JavaScript enabled and local file access to this standalone bundle
Eight fixed synthetic journey labels; no identities, credentials, tokens or cookies
Exactly two or four attempted candidate journeys and separate old-only controls
actions: Choose one of six fixed outcome fixtures
Attempt expansion gate without executing another stage
Predict SUCCESS, FAILURE or UNKNOWN and check
syntheticInput: Six immutable enum-only outcome fixtures, two allowlisted pilot sizes, eight fixed journey labels, six checked attempts maximum
expectedAssertions: Forced reauthentication, rejected valid sessions and rejected sign-in checks stop admission and block expansion
Validation is always required; no bypass or real authentication operations exist
Interruptions and unknowns remain counted; old-only controls cannot inflate successes
Missing evidence is UNKNOWN; a known failure plus unknown remains FAILURE with the unknown retained
Compatible evidence permits only an unexecuted synthetic next-stage gate check
Learner PASS does not change a FAILURE or UNKNOWN journey result
Input, state, phase and history bounds fail closed without mutation
Keyboard operation, explicit reset, retained history and strict CSP work in the actual browser
limits: One measured pilot and one unexecuted expansion-gate check per attempt
All authentication and session outcomes are fixed synthetic fixtures
No actual credentials, tokens, cookies, registration, identity or session operations
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, deployment, spend, packages or frameworks
No native Azure, actual authentication, reauthentication or session-continuity certification
No production Node.js 24 validation, source-parent completion or five-nines claim
History is bounded page memory only; explicit reset or reload clears it
